# zoneinfo v0.1.9 - Table of Contents

> Elixir time zone support that uses OS-supplied zoneinfo files

## Pages

- [Zoneinfo](https://zoneinfo.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Piston.ZoneInfoHelper](https://zoneinfo.hexdocs.pm/Piston.ZoneInfoHelper.md): A Zone Info helper

- [Zoneinfo](https://zoneinfo.hexdocs.pm/Zoneinfo.md): Elixir time zone support for your OS-supplied time zone database
- [Zoneinfo.Meta](https://zoneinfo.hexdocs.pm/Zoneinfo.Meta.md): Metadata derived from TZif information
- [Zoneinfo.TimeZoneDatabase](https://zoneinfo.hexdocs.pm/Zoneinfo.TimeZoneDatabase.md): `Calendar.TimeZoneDatabase` implementation for Zoneinfo
